# terraform-provider-unified Provider

The Unified provider is used to interact with Infoblox NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    unified = {
      source  = "infobloxopen/unified"
      version = "0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "unified" {
  nios = {
    host_url = "<NIOS_HOST_URL>"
    username = "<NIOS_USERNAME>"
    password = "<NIOS_PASSWORD>"
  }
}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    unified = {
      source  = "infobloxopen/unified"
      version = "0.0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "unified" {
  uddi = {
    csp_url = "<CSP_URL>"
    api_key = "<API_KEY>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `nios` (Attributes) Configuration for NIOS backend. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios))
- `uddi` (Attributes) Configuration for UDDI backend. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))

<a id="nestedatt--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nios`

Optional:

- `host_url` (String) URL for the NIOS host
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the NIOS host
- `username` (String) Username for the NIOS host


<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for accessing the UDDI API.
- `csp_url` (String) URL for UDDI Cloud Services Portal
